name: Happy Belly Health by Shanti Pappas
blurb: Shanti operates as a National Board-Certified Health & Wellness Coach (NBC-HWC) and Functional Medicine Practitioner with advanced training from The School of Applied Functional Medicine and is a Certified Quantum Coach.
long: Shanti Pappas is the Digestion and Weight Expert since 2010. I help busy people like you address digestion and weight issues including concerns related to SIBO and IBS. SIBO and IBS are digestive health conditions that can affect gut function and may contribute to symptoms such as bloating discomfort and changes in digestion. I am a National Board Certified Health Coach and Advanced Certified Functional Medicine Nutritionist. I take a holistic approach to health and wellness looking at each area of your life and how it connects to your symptoms challenges and concerns. I then put together a specific plan for you to make lasting food and lifestyle shifts that can support improved energy restore balance and enhance your overall health and well-being.
